{{Top|leg}}
A '''holo-player''' was a device that played [[Hologram/Legends|holos]]. The [[Chevin/Legends|Chevin]] [[Phrusaani]], who enjoyed [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] [[Music/Legends|music]], kept a holo-player stocked with a nearly complete collection of [[Figrin D'an and the Modal Nodes/Legends|Modal Nodes]] holos.
